coverage.tip_method: Resolve each named ref to a commit, enumerate .py entries using git ls-tree -r, and deduplicate by Git blob object id. Candidate implementations were filtered for activation and sampling tokens, then inspected by function and dispatch behavior.
coverage.history_method: Enumerate git rev-list --objects --all from the fetched local repository, select objects with a .py path, deduplicate object ids, and read object bodies using git cat-file --batch. Screen for sigmoid/tanh/SiLU/act_fn together with random or sampling operations. Manually inspect matching FFN implementations, dispatch, and associated result reports.
coverage.deduplication_key: Git object id, not file path or branch name
coverage.manual_review_boundary: 506 describes automatically read and screened historical Python objects; it does not claim that every line of every object received manual review.
